messages:
maya: deploy-bot held the release promo due to CI failing on remote-cache checksum mismatch for build-artifact v4.2. deploy-bot: "cache-verify mismatch key=build-v4.2 part=3 expected=5d2a...ef got=badc...00". We need decision: rebuild or pin previous release?

noor: logs show cache node-node12 served a corrupted chunk during fetch. origin storage has expected checksum.

otto: rebuild will take ~22m and likely misses our change window. pin to v4.1.1 (last-green) to keep window. open ticket for cache-node health and replicate-scan.

pat: agree pin. patch/hotfix can be submitted after cache heal. also suggest disabling auto-promo for 12h to avoid repeats.

maya: /deploybot approve promote release --id=v4.1.1 --reason "pin last-green due to cache node chunk corruption"

deploy-bot: ACK. manual approval recorded. queued artifact-verify against v4.1.1 (no rebuild).

ci-bot: artifact-verify passed. canary-smoke queued and green. deploy-bot: PROMOTE_COMPLETE: release -> v4.1.1

noor: filed INF-3333: cache-node12 multipart corruption + missing post-fetch-verify. assigned to infra.

maya: release note blurb: "Promotion pinned to previously verified build after detection of remote cache chunk corruption; origin artifacts unchanged. Investigating INF-3333."

otto: will add fail-fast on cache fetch checksum mismatch in publish pipeline.

pat: blocking auto-promotes until INF-3333 is resolved. closing thread once ticket is visible.
